name: Kaide, the Drowned Light
desc:
Kaide is a Lightborn NPC. He was the last king of the fallen city [Constellia](location:constellia), one of the largest Celestial Cities in the Heavens.

As the king of Constellia, he was imprisoned in the outskirts of New Kyrsa after the invasion by the Kyrsans under Ethiron's will, the sole survivor of the conflict. Kaide was set to be killed during the final days of the war, but due to the intervention of Raeva Ferash Kenestos was captured instead. He mentions about the limited power of the Song and the unsuccessful war between the Celestials and Lightborn against the Drowned Gods, eventually leading to the Celestials fleeing and the Lightborn losing morale, giving up in the process.

Kaide is an aged man with purple eyes and a stern expression. He has long white hair styled into curtain bangs, symmetrically hanging down to his abdomen. His armor consists of gray robes laid over a black, long-sleeved top that features patterns on each sleeve. Lesser aspects such as his pouches and gloves take a dark brown color. A large, bright lavender halo fashioned into a crown with numerous spikes circling it. On his hand is a dark, faded purple twinblade that sports a zig-zag blade with numerous four-pronged star embellishments in between.
additional_info:
-   The "immortals" that Kaide mentions in his dialogue are presumably the Deepwoken. His hesitation when he mentions this brings up the possibility that the term is a sacred or touchy subject. It also could mean that the Pathfinder and other people in Lumen cannot comprehend the concept of a Deepwoken.
    -   When he references immortal individuals ruling the world from the shadows, he may be referring to [Drallis Ehr](entity:drallis_ehr), the ageless ruler of [The Central Authority](faction:the_central_authority) who is famed for his secrecy.
-   The relics mentioned by Kaide may be referring to the [Moon's Eyrie](location:moons_eyrie) and the Resonant Dawn event, which are both found in the [Voidsea](location:voidsea).
-   Kaide's old appearance consisted of the Soren outfit, deep purple eyes, with the halo of the same color hanging over his wolf cut.
-   Kaide is one of the only NPCs to have special dialogue depending on the Pathfinder's weapon and Oath.
    -   When speaking to Kaide with a Kyrsieger equipped, he judges the Pathfinder as the Kyrsieger was used in an assault on Constellia, the city Kaide ruled over.
    -   When speaking to Kaide with a Soulthorn equipped, he reminisces Zhatarn, a Celestial that was exiled from the Heavens who once wielded the Soulthorn.
    -   When speaking to him while having Oath: Starkindred, he recognizes the scent of Celestials, calling the Pathfinder "Depraved" as they used to be. Even though he scorns Celestials because of betrayal, he "had hoped better, not sure himself why" when felt their scent from the Pathfinder.
-   Lightborn, due to being immortal, do not often show signs of aging. Despite this, Kaide has noticeable under-eye wrinkles consistent with stage 2 of the aging process. According to [Mikhail Spellhardt](entity:mikhail_spellhardt), a Lightborn will change appearance over time if something is weighing on their mind and soul, so Kaide's wrinkles may be a result of him "feeling old" or having many responsibilities that weigh upon his mind constantly.
